pages.title: Features
pages.content:
Featuresbuilt for the counter

Kazoe does four jobs and does them without a manual. Ring up sales on your phone, tablet or the web, and the app keeps the day in one running total.

Daily close in one tap

At closing time, tap once. Kazoe tallies cash, card and other payment methods, compares them with what you counted, and files a closing report you can read in under a minute.

Tax-period exports

Choose a month or a quarter and export CSV or PDF summaries with each tax rate on its own line, ready to send to your accountant.

Receipt photos

Snap a receipt and attach it to the day it belongs to. Receipt scanning is an add-on at €3 per month for up to 200 receipts.

Share with your accountant

Add a read-only accountant seat for €4 per month. Your bookkeeper sees the closing reports without touching your sales.

See the plans

pages.title: Pricing
pages.content:
Simple monthly plans

Prices in euros per month, VAT excluded. Annual billing includes 2 months free, and every paid plan comes with a 30-day free trial. No card required.

Questions about plans

  • Can I change plans? Yes, at any time; the change applies from the next billing day.
  • Is there a contract? No. Cancel from the app whenever you like.
  • Do I need a card for the trial? No.
Start free

pages.title: About
pages.content:
AboutKazoe Books

Kazoe Books was founded in 2022 by Inês Carvalho and Tomás Weber in Lisbon, Portugal. Having watched neighborhood shopkeepers spend late evenings balancing cash registers and sorting paper receipts, they built Kazoe around one promise: close the day in one tap.

The app was developed alongside corner cafés, florists and bike repair shops, and runs on iOS, Android and the web. Inês led product design while Tomás directed engineering. They were joined by support lead Amara Okoye and certified accountant Lena Fischer.

The team

  • Inês Carvalho, co-founder, product
  • Tomás Weber, co-founder, engineering
  • Amara Okoye, support lead
  • Lena Fischer, bookkeeping advisor, certified accountant

We work remotely from Lisbon, with transparent pricing and replies within one business day.

Write to us

pages.title: Privacy
pages.content:
Privacy

Kazoe stores the sales you record so it can build your closing reports and exports. We do not sell your data and we do not show advertising.

You can export or delete your shop data at any time from the app, or by writing to hello@kazoe.example.

posts.title: Closing the day in one tap
posts.excerpt: Why the closing report is one screen, and what it checks before it files.
posts.content:
The closing report started as a paper slip taped inside a till. We moved it to one screen: cash, card and other payments, counted against what the app expects.

When the numbers match, one tap files the day. When they do not, Kazoe shows the difference and lets you add a note instead of hunting through receipts.

posts.title: A quarter of receipts in ten minutes
posts.excerpt: How a florist sends complete tax-period summaries without a shoebox.
posts.content:
Mei-Ling photographs receipts as they arrive and attaches them to the right day. At quarter end she exports one PDF.

Her accountant opens it, checks each tax rate line, and asks fewer questions than before.

posts.title: What your accountant actually needs
posts.excerpt: Lena Fischer on the three columns every tax-period export should have.
posts.content:
Lena advises the team on exports. Her short list: a date, a tax rate and a net amount on every line.

Kazoe builds CSV and PDF exports in exactly that shape, with the accountant seat as a read-only view.
